title: HB 42 (2025-2026 (136th General Assembly)): H. B. No. 42: Require certain agencies to collect and report citizenship data
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) 2965.01 (new): law enforcement agencies record the citizenship or immigration status of each detained person and report yearly counts to the attorney general
(other) 2965.02 (new): corrections department records and reports citizenship/immigration status of people in detention
(other) 3301.0714, 3301.0717: public schools report yearly numbers of students by citizenship/immigration status
(other) 5101.546 (new): county job and family services collect and report household citizenship data for food assistance
(other) 3722.15, 5107.101 (new): similar reports for other public programs listed in the governor's summary
(other) 107.26 (new): governor sends a yearly summary report to the General Assembly (due March 31)
(other) note: Citizenship-data reporting bill for agencies. It has no voter ID, provisional ballot, voter registration or proof-of-citizenship-to-vote text (no elector/voter/ballot terms in the sections I read). Sole version.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
